# Muse Invite Hub

> An independent, free, open-source directory of community-shared Muse invite codes maintained by ePlus.DEV, not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Muse or Meta.

This guide helps readers and AI agents find public information. It is not a live code-validity feed. Codes, eligibility, redemption success, rewards, and reported invite counts are not guaranteed. Owner confirmation confirms ownership only. Only Muse can confirm whether a code works.

## Website

- [Muse Invite Hub](https://muse.eplus.dev/): Search, copy, and browse public community-shared invite codes.
- [Owner-confirmed invite DPNIHH](https://muse.eplus.dev/codes/DPNIHH/): Site-owner-confirmed code; redemption remains unverified, and any remaining count is a dated report.
- [Muse official website](https://muse.ai/): Refer to Muse for current code redemption instructions, eligibility and terms.

## Contribute and provide feedback

- [Share a public invite code](https://github.com/ePlus-DEV/muse-invite-hub/issues/new?template=share-code.yml): Suggest a code through GitHub.
- [Report your redemption experience](https://muse.eplus.dev/#codes): Provide non-sensitive community feedback.
- [Update a reported count](https://muse.eplus.dev/#codes): Select the existing code and post a dated owner-reported snapshot on its linked Issue.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/ePlus-DEV/muse-invite-hub/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Read moderation and review rules.

## Countries with announced Muse availability (checked 12 November 2026)

Meta has confirmed rollouts in the United States, Canada, Japan, Singapore, and Mexico. Browse the source-linked [interactive country availability map](https://muse.eplus.dev/countries/) or the [compact homepage country list](https://muse.eplus.dev/#availability) before attempting registration. Vietnam is not in the verified launch list. The list can change, and an invite code does not bypass geographic restrictions or guarantee access.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://muse.eplus.dev/sitemap.xml): Lists Home and every published code-detail page (including unverified community reports); listing does not mean Muse has accepted any code.
- [Open-source repository](https://github.com/ePlus-DEV/muse-invite-hub): View project source and documentation.
